finalText:
I worked all 9 open flight-change requests from 27 Jul. Every move kept the customer's cabin and went onto a scheduled flight I'd checked had seats. Each request is resolved with a note telling the customer what they got and what they paid.

Three customers expected a free change under a waiver they didn't qualify for: Q-302, Q-303 and Q-305. Following the rules, I still made the change they asked for, charged the normal fees and explained why in the resolution note. All charges are on the reservations' ledgers.

| Request | Change | Charge | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| Q-301 R5201 | AA210 → DL542 (6 Aug) | $0 | Chicago weather waiver (PB-2026-14) covers it, so the change fee and fare difference are waived. |
| Q-302 R5202 | AA660 → AA664 (7 Aug, Boston) | $75 change fee + $35 fare difference | The Chicago waiver only covers O'Hare, so normal economy rules apply. |
| Q-303 R5203 | AA662 → AA664 (7 Aug), basic economy | $150 change fee + $25 fare difference | The customer cited the hurricane waiver PB-2026-09, but it expired 15 Jul and only covered travel 1–20 Jul. Bulletin PB-2026-16 sets the basic economy change fee at $150; silver status isn't exempt. |
| Q-304 R5204 | UA88 → UA90 (9 Aug), basic economy | $35 fare difference | The Chicago waiver applies, but on basic economy fares it still collects the fare difference. |
| Q-305 R5205 | AA214 → AA216 (8 Aug) | $75 change fee + $10 fare difference | Ticketed 26 Jul, after the waiver's 24 Jul ticketing cutoff. |
| Q-307 R5207 | AA212 → AA218 (8 Aug) | $0 | The customer offered to pay, but as a platinum member he's covered: amendment PB-2026-14A extends the waiver to 5 Aug for gold and platinum members. |
| Q-308 R5208 | AA660 → AA662, same day (5 Aug) | $75 change fee | Same-day change rule (PB-2026-12): flat fee, no fare difference. That's cheaper than the normal fee plus the $13 fare difference. |
| Q-309 R5209 | Second flight only: AA1402 → AA1406 (Chicago–Boston, 3 Aug); first flight unchanged | $0 | Both the Chicago waiver and the same-day rule apply. PB-2026-17 says to use the one that costs the customer least, which is the waiver. |
| Q-310 R5210 | AA210 → AA216 (8 Aug) | $75 change fee + $30 fare difference | The waiver allows one free move per booking, and this one was already used on 26 Jul (AA214 → AA210). |

I left Q-306 (R5206) open because it's a cancellation request, not a flight change.

The system date is 2026-07-28, not the 2026-10-05 given in my session context. I treated 28 Jul as today, which matches the queue's "yesterday" (27 Jul) and decides which bulletins were in effect.
